name: Dark Cyan
lede: Dark cyan is a web color: a deep blue-green defined in the X11 set and carried into CSS.

sections.title: A web color
sections.body:
Paterson lists *DarkCyan* as one of the colors of the X11 set, with the hex code #008B8B [1]. The dictionary defines cyan itself as a greenish blue and one of the three subtractive primary colours [1]. The prefix *cyano-* comes from the Greek for blue [1]. The color is also in the xkcd survey of 2010 [2].

Its closest named neighbor is [[teal]], at a CIEDE2000 distance of 4.0 [2]. The books say nothing more about this exact shade, so its history is the history of the web list: origin undocumented.

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Dark cyan is almost absent from museum paint. In our archive of 23,781 paintings it appears in five, and only one by the stricter test of covering at least 1% of the canvas [3]. It is rarer than 86% of the named colors [3]. These are photographs of varnished paintings, so read them as screen colors [3].
